description:
Sacrifice Eternal Scourge to Ashnod's Altar adding {C}{C}.
Activate Titans' Nest, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard.
Cast Eternal Scourge using the 3 mana produced.
Repeat for infinite ETB, LTB, and storm.
